The '''Picket Fleet''' was the space navy of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="HSCS" />

==Organization==
The Picket Fleet was part of the Corporate Sector's [[Security Police/Legends|Security Division]], and as such, its primary role was policing against non-military opponents. It was organized to take on smugglers and pirates.<ref name="HSCS" />

===Larger warships===
The Corporate Sector devoted no significant resources to the construction of large warships, preferring instead to acquire them from abroad.

The Picket Fleet's usual procurement policy was to acquire large, old ships that were being discarded by other navies. These were almost always slow and obsolescent, but the sheer quantity of firepower they could carry would overpower most of the Picket Fleet's paramilitary opponents.<ref name="HSCS" /> As [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] consolidated and modernized his military forces, whole fleets of older warships became available, ranging from ancient heavy cruisers that had served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] centuries earlier, through veteran Star Destroyers from the Clone Wars, to former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] warships.

For many years, the core of the Picket Fleet was a force of 520 [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyers]] purchased from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="HSCS" /> Other veteran warships from the Clone Wars were added as available, such as a force of six [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]].<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> A number of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleships]] and [[Core ship/Legends|Core Ships]] were also acquired at this time by the Corporate Sector.<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Perhaps the most distinctive warships in the Picket Fleet were a number of large, ancient [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruisers]], originally built for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. These were already around three thousand years old at the time of their acquisition, but their large hulls could carry many weapons and troops, and their simple systems made them easy for Espo crews to operate. By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], however, only a few of these old ships remained.

After the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], many warships were once again surplus to the needs of other naval forces, and the Picket Fleet acquired a large number of these, notably including one [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> In the years, after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Picket Fleet also made use of an Escort Carrier design, which may have been the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|500-meter Kuat Drive Yards design]].<ref name="Twin Stars of Kira">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>

===Small cruisers and starfighters===
The smaller ships used by the Picket Fleet, built in the Corporate Sector's own yards, were typically no larger than [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], although they were often referred to as [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]]. Other designations for smaller Picket Fleet vessels are known, however, including [[Sloop (warship)|sloop]] and [[Gunboat/Legends|gunboat]].<ref name="Twin Stars of Kira" />

The standard design for many years was the [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]]. Originally developed by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]], the rights to the design were acquired by the Corporate Sector after it failed to make an impact in other markets. Alongside this, the Picket Fleet also used a [[Etti light cruiser|militarized version]] of the Corporate Sector's locally-developed [[Etti Lighter|''Etti''-class light transport]]. Both these types were capable of carrying out the role for which they were built, but both were developed by the Corporate Sector without designing a warship class from the keel up.

Throughout the Galactic Civil War, surplus Picket Fleet corvettes were sold to other fleets, in a reversal of the Corporate Sector's acquisition policy for larger warships.<ref name="EaW/VotF">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' has the Rebel Alliance using the ''Marauder''-class design, while ''[[Vision of the Future]]'' has the [[Diamal]] acquiring a flotilla of the same ships in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> Also, vessels were sometimes built for export.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' refers to the [[Cutlass-class corvette|''Cutlass''-class cruiser]] being used by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].</ref> By the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Corporate Sector's shipyards were building a new type of corvette-sized "cruiser", [[Cutlass-class corvette|''Cutlass''-class]], which was used by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and probably also by the Picket Fleet itself.<ref name="CSWE" />

Some smaller Picket Fleet ships were acquired from outside in the same way as the larger warships. After the end of the Galactic Civil War, for example, a small number of military-surplus [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] were purchased from other navies.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />

The Picket Fleet also made use of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Like the corvettes, these were usually built locally, but sometimes using foreign designs. The standard Picket Fleet starfighter was the home-grown [[IRD starfighter|IRD and IRD-A]],<ref name="HSCS" /> but other types were produced as well, such as the [[Mankvim-814 light interceptor/Legends|Mankvim-814 light interceptor]], a [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] design acquired after the Clone Wars, and constructed in limited numbers.<ref name="SOTG07" /> The [[TIS Zeta 19]] was a starfighter common in the hangars of Corporate Sector stations<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> .

===Personnel===
Many of the Picket Fleet's senior and mid-level officers were recruited from other military forces, and particularly from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], such as [[Baruche Sloane]],<ref name="Twin Stars of Kira" /> [[Jona Grumby]]<ref name="HSCS" /> and [[Milo Phineas]].<ref name="Twin Stars of Kira" />

The ranks used by the Picket Fleet were similar to those used in other naval services.<ref name="HSCS" /><ref name="Tempest Feud" /><ref name="Twin Stars of Kira" />

===Deployment===
Typically, Corporate Sector warships operated individually. Sometimes, however, the Picket Fleet could deploy a sizable task force to seize control of a star system from a foreign fleet. One example of larger-scale operations of this sort occurred after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], when a powerful Picket Fleet task force, led by the ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer ''[[Enforce]]'', intervened at [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]].
